description: Diagnostic procedure for failure of the code reader to read part ID codes at the metrology station, covering marking contrast, reader optics, illumination, and code geometry.

box_1.text: Record the read failure rate (number of failed reads per hundred parts), the error type shown on the operator control interface, and the batch number of the affected parts.

box_2.text: Is the read failure occurring on all parts or only on a fraction of the batch?

box_3.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect five failed parts for inconsistent marking contrast. 2. Compare with a successfully read part from the same batch.

box_4.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the read history log on the code reader diagnostic display. 2. Verify the failure rate is consistent across all positions on the part. 3. Check for a correlation between failures and a specific part feature.

box_5.text: Is the marking contrast on the affected parts within the minimum contrast specification?

box_6.text: Measure the optical contrast of the code marking on three failed parts using the contrast measurement tool and compare against the minimum contrast threshold.

box_7.text: Adjust the laser power or marking speed at the marking station to restore contrast to within specification. remark the affected parts if feasible.

box_8.text: Is the code reader lens clean and free of contamination?

box_9.text: Inspect the code reader lens surface for dust, oil, or condensation. Verify that the reader housing cover is intact and that no stray light enters the reading field.

box_10.text: Clean the code reader lens with an approved optical cleaning cloth and lens cleaner. retest the read rate with five known good parts.

box_11.text: Is the illumination intensity at the reading position within specification?

box_12.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Read the illumination intensity from the code reader diagnostic display. 2. Compare against the minimum specified illumination level. 3. Check the illumination module for contamination or connector issues.

box_13.text: Replace the illuminator indicator light module if the output is below specification. retest the read rate after replacement.

box_14.text: Is the code geometry (module size, quiet zone, aspect ratio) within the specification for this code type?

box_15.text: Use the code reader diagnostic software to inspect the decoded code geometry parameters. Compare module size and quiet zone width against the code specification for this product.

box_16.text: Remark the affected parts at the correct code geometry specification, or reject the batch if the marking station cannot produce the correct geometry.

box_17.text: Has the read success rate returned to within the acceptable threshold after corrections?

box_18.text: Escalate to the maintenance team: code read failures persist after all standard corrective actions; inspect the code reader mounting, focus, and trigger timing.

box_19.text: Record all corrective actions and the final read success rate in the quality log. Notify quality assurance team of the affected batch.

box_21.text: Is the code read failure rate so high that part traceability cannot be maintained, requiring an immediate production stop and traceability audit?

box_22.text: End, production stopped immediately: traceability compromised, quarantine all unverified parts from current shift and escalate to quality assurance engineer
